_about: Package name -> extra product names to look up (products) and the only vendors that count (vendors). Names are compared lowercase, with spaces and underscores as hyphens. ~/.config/ward/names.json overrides these package by package.
_why: python, ruby, brotli: NVD matched microsoft:python (a VS Code extension), a GitLab CVE, and andybalholm:brotli (a Go port). snappy, graphene: CVE.org's only records are KnpLabs/dain snappy and silverks graphene, not google/snappy or ebassi/graphene (their URLs in pacman -Qi). Measured 2026-11-20.
